items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 4:39 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Noise Exemption, Grand River Hospital Foundation Rally for Health, CSD-2023-205
notes: Council considered Community Services Department report DSD-2023-205, dated April 18, 2023, recommending approval of noise exemptions for the Grand River Hospital Foundation Rally for Health being held on May 26th and 27th, 2023, which was considered at Community and Infrastructure Services Committee earlier this date.

items.title: Downtown Kitchener BIA and Belmont BIA 2023 Budgets Referenced in the 2023 Tax Rate By-law, FIN-2023-235
notes: Council considered Financial Services Department report FIN-2023-235, dated May 4, 2023, recommending approval of the 2023 Budgets for the Downtown Kitchener Business Improvement Area (BIA) and the Belmont Business Improvement Area (BIA).

attachments.name: Attachment A- Kitchener Downtown BIA 2023 Budget.pdf

items.title: Recess and Reconvene
notes: Special Council recessed at 4:42 p.m. and reconvened at 5:45 p.m., Chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic, with all members present except Councillor P. Singh.

items.title: Presentation - 50th Anniversary of Waterloo Region Police Services (WRPS)
notes: Mayor Vrbanovic made a presentation to Chief Mark Crowell of the Waterloo Regional Police Service to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the police service serving the residents of the City of Kitchener and the broader region. The presentation coincides with Police Week 2023.

items.title: Being a by-law to set and levy the rates of taxation for City purposes for the year 2023 and to provide for the payment of taxes after interim taxes.
To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for May 15, 2023.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 5:52 p.m.

motions.item_title: Noise Exemption, Grand River Hospital Foundation Rally for Health, CSD-2023-205
motions.text: "That an exemption to Chapter 450 (Noise) of the City of Kitchener Municipal Code be granted for the Grand River Hospital Foundation Rally for Health on Saturday May 27, 2023, which will be held in the Sun Life parking lot located at 969 King St W from 4pm – 10pm; and further, That a further noise exemption be granted for sound checks and rehearsals that will take place the previous evening on May 26, 2023 from 5pm - 8pm, as outlined in Community Services Department report CSD-2023-205."
